description: Personal credit institution balance-sheet skeleton adapted from the bank profile and the supplied OneMain reference presentation. All 113 user-supplied industry concepts are retained once. Presentation is unclassified; measurement alternatives and supplementary disclosures remain distinct.
classification_notes: The user-supplied SIC 6141 list defines the concept universe; appearance thresholds have not been recomputed.
OneMain is a presentation reference, not evidence that every industry concept applies to OneMain. Deposit and insurance balances are retained where supplied.
Hierarchy, sibling order and total node kinds do not imply addition, equivalence or a complete reconciliation. Missing facts are not zeros.
reference presentation analytical net debt and unsupported presentation subtotals are not invented as reported concepts.
Review filing dimensions, consolidation scope, measurement basis, redemption terms and signs before production mapping.

sources.description: 113 unique us-gaap concepts supplied by the user for SIC 6141.
FASB US GAAP 2026 taxonomy schema and documentation.

nodes.label: Total Assets
nodes.classification_note: Reported total assets; children describe presentation categories and overlapping reported measurements, not an instruction to sum.

children.label: Cash and Bank Balances
children.classification_note: Cash, cash equivalents and amounts due from banks have different scopes and may overlap. Bank placements are assets, distinct from customer deposit liabilities.

children.label: Restricted Cash and Investments
children.classification_note: Restriction and maturity are separate attributes. Current restricted cash is a subset; combined cash and investments overlap restricted cash-only balances. Do not add these alternatives together.

children.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Current
Investments and Securities
children.classification_note: Broad investment totals overlap accounting-classification and instrument-level balances. No maturity or equivalence is inferred from this hierarchy.

children.label: Investment and Securities Totals
children.classification_note: Investments and marketable securities can cover overlapping portfolios and are alternative reported scopes.

children.label: Trading Securities
children.classification_note: Debt trading securities are a possible subset of total trading securities; amortized cost is retained separately in supplementary disclosures.

children.label: Available-for-Sale Debt Securities
children.classification_note: Accrued-interest inclusion may differ between these carrying balances; amortized-cost and restricted portfolio disclosures are separate.

children.label: AFS Debt Securities, Excluding Accrued Interest
Other Investments
children.classification_note: Other investments can be included in broader investment totals; inspect issuer scope before presenting both.

children.label: Loans and Financing Receivables
children.classification_note: reference presentation presents OMF finance receivables in total net receivables. This profile preserves loan measurement distinctions rather than treating all receivables as equivalent. Gross balances, allowances, fees and net balances must not be added.

children.label: Net Loan Balances
children.classification_note: Notes receivable and financing receivables excluding accrued interest may overlap but are not interchangeable totals.

children.label: Financing Receivables, Net, Excluding Accrued Interest
Gross Loans and Measurement Alternatives
children.classification_note: Before-allowance balances differ in fee and accrued-interest scope. None is an automatic additive component of another.

children.label: Financing Receivables, Before Allowance and Fees
Financing Receivables, Before Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest
Loan Credit Loss Allowances
children.classification_note: Allowance measurements may differ in accrued-interest scope. Contra identifies an offsetting balance and does not prescribe negating a reported fact.

children.label: Financing Receivable Credit Loss Allowance
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine reported sign and any presentation adjustment from the filing. Do not negate automatically.

children.label: Financing Receivable Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine reported sign and any presentation adjustment from the filing. Do not negate automatically.

children.label: Unamortized Loan Fees and Costs
children.classification_note: Loan fees and costs adjust yield and may already be included in loan carrying values; direction and netting require filing context.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableUnamortizedLoanFeeCost
concepts.review_reason: Unamortized origination and commitment costs (fees) adjust loan yield; verify whether the reported balance is a cost or fee and whether it is already included in net finance receivables.

children.label: Other Asset Categories
children.classification_note: Recognized asset categories can be included in reported other-asset totals; nesting does not establish a complete or additive reconciliation.

children.label: Loans Held for Sale
children.classification_note: Net balances outside disposal groups and unspecified held-for-sale balances have distinct scopes.

children.label: Loans Held for Sale, Net, Outside Disposal Groups
Property, Equipment and Right-of-Use Assets
children.classification_note: Operating lease right-of-use assets are distinct from owned property and equipment; reported other-asset totals may include either.

children.label: Interest and Other Receivables
children.classification_note: Trade, interest and other receivables are distinct from loan principal. Broad net balances may include narrower components; allowances are not additional assets.

children.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine reported sign and any presentation adjustment from the filing. Do not negate automatically.

children.label: Deferred Tax Assets
children.classification_note: Net deferred tax assets are retained as reported; do not offset against separately reported deferred tax liabilities without jurisdiction and filing context.

children.label: Goodwill and Intangible Assets
children.classification_note: Intangibles including goodwill overlap goodwill plus intangibles excluding goodwill. Preserve each reported measurement without summing all three.

children.label: Other Assets and Prepayments
children.classification_note: Other assets, miscellaneous assets, prepayments and interest-earning residuals have overlapping issuer-defined scopes; none supplies a maturity classification by itself.

children.label: Income Tax Receivables
children.classification_note: Current tax receivables are kept distinct from deferred tax assets and are not automatically offset against accrued tax liabilities.

nodes.label: Total Liabilities
nodes.classification_note: Reported total liabilities; the child categories preserve overlapping totals and components rather than prescribing a calculation.

children.label: Borrowings and Lease Liabilities
children.classification_note: Combined debt, maturity, collateral, seniority and conversion features are overlapping axes. Operating leases remain separate from debt totals that exclude leases; do not sum all groups.

children.label: Reported Debt Totals and Instrument Balances
children.classification_note: Combined short- and long-term debt is a reported total. Debt instrument carrying amounts may describe individual instruments or dimensional subsets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount
concepts.review_reason: A carrying amount can describe one debt instrument or a dimensional class rather than total borrowings; verify instrument and consolidation scope before using it as a debt total.

children.label: Short-Term Borrowings
children.classification_note: Only concepts with explicit short-term scope are placed here; absence of a maturity qualifier elsewhere does not make debt current.

children.label: Long-Term Debt
children.classification_note: LongTermDebt excludes lease obligations. Its treatment of the current portion must be checked against issuer presentation rather than inferred from this group name.

children.label: Debt by Instrument and Security
children.classification_note: Secured, senior, convertible and bank-note balances may describe the same obligations. Senior notes including current portions overlap senior long-term notes excluding current portions.

children.label: Operating Lease Liabilities
children.classification_note: Operating lease obligations are distinct from debt measurements excluding leases; do not assume reference presentation total debt includes this balance.

children.label: Total Deposits
children.classification_note: Customer deposit liabilities are distinct from deposits placed with banks on the asset side. Retained because these concepts are supplied for the industry universe.

children.label: Deposits by Interest Status
children.classification_note: Interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing deposit balances are retained for issuers reporting deposit-taking operations; OMF alone does not define industry-wide applicability.

children.label: Insurance Policy Liabilities
children.classification_note: Insurance policy reserves and unearned premiums are retained for industry issuers with insurance operations. Broad other-liability balances may already include them.

children.label: Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims Reserves
Customer Contract Liabilities
children.classification_note: Performance obligations to customers are distinct from debt, deposits and insurance reserves; current versus noncurrent scope requires issuer context.

children.label: Deferred Commitment Fee Income
children.classification_note: Fees for commitments unlikely to be exercised are deferred service income under the taxonomy definition, distinct from loan-yield fees and loan allowances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableDeferredIncome
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy defines this balance as commitment fees deferred for future service income when exercise is remote; check issuer recognition and avoid subtracting it from loan principal as an origination-fee adjustment.

children.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities
children.classification_note: Net deferred tax liabilities are separate from current income taxes and other taxes payable; no asset-liability offset is assumed.

children.label: Income and Other Taxes Payable
children.classification_note: Income tax accruals are a possible subset of all taxes payable. Both concepts include current and noncurrent amounts and are alternative overlapping scopes.

children.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Current and Noncurrent
Other Liabilities, Payables and Accruals
children.classification_note: Other-liability totals overlap accrued liabilities, vendor payables and interest. Current-only payables are a subset of combined current and noncurrent balances; no automatic addition is valid.

children.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current and Noncurrent
Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current

nodes.label: Total Equity Including Noncontrolling Interest
nodes.classification_note: Reported consolidated equity total overlaps parent equity; do not sum alternative equity totals. Temporary-equity terms in supplementary disclosures do not create a carrying balance.

children.label: Shareholders' Equity Attributable to Parent
children.classification_note: Parent equity excludes noncontrolling interests. Preferred stock remains provisional pending redemption classification.

children.label: Common Equity Components
children.classification_note: No common-equity subtotal is invented. These are reported components within parent equity, with treasury stock a contra balance.

children.label: Common Stock Carrying Values
children.classification_note: Issued and outstanding stock carrying values may differ; neither is a share count or per-share par amount.

children.label: Additional Paid-in Capital
children.classification_note: Common-stock additional paid-in capital can be included in total additional paid-in capital; do not add both.

children.label: Retained Earnings
children.classification_note: Accumulated earnings or deficit is a stock balance distinct from current-period net income.

children.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
children.classification_note: Reported total or subtotal; its node kind and any children do not prescribe a calculation.

children.label: Treasury Stock
children.classification_note: Common treasury stock may be included in total treasury stock. Contra does not prescribe the sign of an imported fact.

children.label: Treasury Stock Carrying Value
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine reported sign and any presentation adjustment from the filing. Do not negate automatically.

children.label: Common Treasury Stock Carrying Value
children.classification_note: Contra balance; determine reported sign and any presentation adjustment from the filing. Do not negate automatically.

children.label: Preferred Stock Carrying Values
children.classification_note: Carrying values may overlap. Redemption provisions determine permanent equity, temporary equity or liability presentation; per-share terms and liquidation preference disclosures are kept separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValue
concepts.review_reason: This preferred-stock carrying amount is provisionally grouped in parent equity; confirm redemption provisions and whether the filing instead reports it as temporary equity or a liability.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding preferred-stock carrying value can overlap the broader preferred-stock amount; verify redemption classification and whether issued versus outstanding scope affects the reported balance.

nodes.label: Total Liabilities and Equity
nodes.classification_note: Use the reported combined balance. Check filing scope, including any temporary equity, rather than deriving it from all categories.

nodes.label: Supplementary Disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Fair-value exposures, cost bases, financing adjustments, stock quantities and contractual terms are not additional balance-sheet carrying amounts. Review status flags context-dependent use rather than an invalid concept.

children.label: Loan Fair Value Disclosures
children.classification_note: Fair value disclosures are distinct from loan carrying amounts and must not replace net finance receivables.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LoansReceivableFairValueDisclosure
concepts.review_reason: Disclosed loan fair value uses a different measurement basis from net loan carrying value; verify portfolio coverage and dimensions before comparing it with finance receivables.

children.label: Derivative Fair Values Before Netting
children.classification_note: These concepts describe fair values before master-netting effects, including positions elected not to be offset; they do not establish a net recognized derivative line.

children.label: Derivative Asset Fair Value, Before Netting

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAsset
concepts.review_reason: This derivative asset exposure is measured before master-netting effects and excludes assets outside such arrangements; reconcile netting, collateral and covered contracts before using it as a recognized derivative asset total.

children.label: Derivative Liability Fair Value, Before Netting

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability
concepts.review_reason: This derivative liability exposure precedes master-netting effects and excludes liabilities outside such arrangements; confirm netting and contract scope before substituting it for a reported derivative liability balance.

children.label: Securities Cost Bases and Restricted Subsets
children.classification_note: AFS amortized cost before or after allowances, trading debt cost and restricted portfolio subsets overlap carrying amounts but are not equivalent to fair-value balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesAmortizedCostBasis
concepts.review_reason: The AFS amortized-cost basis differs from fair-value carrying value; inspect portfolio and accrued-interest scope before reconciling to AFS securities.

children.label: AFS Amortized Cost, Before Allowance, Excluding Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: This AFS cost basis excludes accrued interest and precedes the credit-loss allowance; do not treat it as the after-allowance amount or fair-value carrying balance.

children.label: AFS Amortized Cost, After Allowance, Excluding Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: This AFS cost basis is already reduced by its credit-loss allowance and excludes accrued interest; avoid applying an allowance again when reconciling to a reported securities amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRestricted
concepts.review_reason: Restricted AFS securities are a subset classified by availability of use; verify whether the amount is included in the AFS portfolio and in restricted cash-and-investment disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TradingSecuritiesDebtAmortizedCost
concepts.review_reason: Amortized cost of trading debt is a supplementary measurement; trading securities are not automatically carried at this cost basis on the balance sheet.

children.label: Combined Cash and Federal Funds Sold
children.classification_note: Combined cash, equivalents and federal funds sold overlap cash-only balances and cannot be used as cash alone.

children.label: Cash, Equivalents and Federal Funds Sold

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsAndFederalFundsSold
concepts.review_reason: This combined amount includes federal funds sold as well as cash and equivalents; verify its components before comparing or reconciling it with cash-only concepts.

children.label: Debt Discounts, Premiums and Issuance Costs
children.classification_note: Net debt adjustments may already be reflected in carrying amounts and are distinct from drawn borrowing balances.

children.label: Unamortized Debt Discount, Premium and Issuance Costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountPremiumAndDebtIssuanceCostsNet
concepts.review_reason: The net adjustment combines discounts, premiums and issuance costs; confirm its sign and whether debt carrying amounts already incorporate it before deriving gross or net debt.

children.label: Common Share Counts and Per-Share Terms
children.classification_note: Authorized, issued, outstanding and treasury shares are distinct stock quantities; par or no-par face amounts per share are not aggregate equity balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesAuthorized
concepts.review_reason: Authorized common shares are an issuance ceiling, not shares actually issued or outstanding; retain the authorization class and date when interpreting this quantity.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued
concepts.review_reason: Issued common shares can include treasury shares; do not substitute this count for shares held by external shareholders.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding common shares are an instant balance by share class, distinct from income-statement weighted-average shares and issued shares.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonShares
concepts.review_reason: This is the number of common shares held in treasury, not the monetary treasury-stock contra balance; confirm the share class and reporting date.

children.label: Common Stock Par or Stated Value per Share

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare
concepts.review_reason: Par or stated value per common share is a contractual unit amount and does not measure total common equity or market price.

children.label: No-Par Common Stock Face Amount per Share

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockNoParValue
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy types this no-par common-stock face amount as per share; do not map it to the aggregate common-stock carrying value.

children.label: Preferred Share Counts and Preferences
children.classification_note: Preferred share counts, aggregate liquidation preferences, per-share preferences and carrying values are different measurements. Redemption terms determine presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesAuthorized
concepts.review_reason: Authorized preferred shares measure a permitted issuance limit, not preferred shares issued or an equity carrying amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesIssued
concepts.review_reason: Issued preferred shares may include shares no longer externally outstanding; inspect the series and treasury-share treatment before using this count.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding preferred shares require series-specific redemption and dividend terms; the quantity alone does not establish permanent-equity classification.

children.label: Preferred Stock Par or Stated Value per Share

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare
concepts.review_reason: Preferred par or stated value is a per-share term; it is distinct from carrying amount and liquidation preference.

children.label: No-Par Preferred Stock Face Amount per Share

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockNoParValue
concepts.review_reason: No-par preferred-stock face amount is a per-share taxonomy measure, not a total preferred-stock balance or a share count.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreference
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy defines this as the per-share excess of liquidation preference over par or stated value; do not treat it as the aggregate redemption amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreferenceValue
concepts.review_reason: This aggregate measure is the difference between liquidation preference and par or stated values, not the preferred-stock carrying amount or a per-share term.

children.label: Temporary Equity Share Counts and Terms
children.classification_note: The supplied temporary-equity concepts describe quantities and contractual preferences. No temporary-equity carrying amount is supplied, so no primary balance or permanent-equity component is invented.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquitySharesAuthorized
concepts.review_reason: Authorized temporary-equity securities describe the maximum issuable quantity; they do not establish that any redeemable securities are currently outstanding.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquitySharesIssued
concepts.review_reason: Issued temporary-equity securities can include treasury holdings; confirm the instrument class and avoid interpreting the quantity as its redemption or carrying amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquitySharesOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding temporary-equity securities are a share quantity; redemption features and balance-sheet carrying amounts must be obtained separately.

children.label: Temporary Equity Par or Stated Value per Share

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquityParOrStatedValuePerShare
concepts.review_reason: Temporary-equity par or stated value per share is a contractual term, not its aggregate mezzanine carrying value or redemption price.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquityLiquidationPreference
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy defines this aggregate liquidation-preference difference relative to par or stated value; do not use it as a temporary-equity carrying balance.

children.label: Commitments and Contingencies
children.classification_note: Commitment and contingency disclosures need recognition and probability context before any amount can be treated as a recognized liability.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingencies
concepts.review_reason: A disclosed commitment or contingency amount may describe unrecognized exposure rather than an accrued obligation; review recognition, scope and dimensions before assigning a primary liability.

children.label: Tax Allocated to AOCI
children.classification_note: Tax allocated to AOCI is not the full net-of-tax accumulated other comprehensive income balance.

children.label: Tax Allocated to AOCI Attributable to Parent

concepts.name: us-gaap:AociTaxAttributableToParent
concepts.review_reason: This measures the parent-attributable tax expense or benefit allocated to AOCI; it is not AOCI itself or a standalone deferred-tax asset or liability.
